main.description: Subscribe the caller to a creator's tier. paymentToken is an opaque reference from the payment processor (CCBill/Segpay/RocketGate) — server does NOT see PAN/CVV. Server charges the token via BPMN http.fetch to the processor, then writes the subscription + entitlement edge. Idempotent per (subscriberDid, creatorDid, tierId).

paymentToken.description: Processor-issued one-time charge token. NEVER a raw card.

errors.name: TierNotFound
errors.description: creatorDid has no active tier with that tierId

errors.name: AgeGateBlock
errors.description: caller age verification missing and tier contains adult content

errors.name: AlreadySubscribed
errors.description: active subscription to same creator already exists
